generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of seeing your own studies that will serve you for the rest of the degree and beyond. You can appraise the engine behind your success, self-regulated learning sustained by self-efficacy. You can evaluate the graduate capital your degree is building across its five forms, and define success on your own terms, backed with evidence of who you have become.

From here these are working habits, not study ideas. Every application you write, every interview you sit, every appraisal you attend asks you to regulate your own work, show the capital you bring, and articulate your development with evidence. The course has rehearsed exactly that, and the same moves serve you long after you graduate.
